listing.fhsz: verify on CAL FIRE map — southern Sierra / Kern River Valley WUI, Kern County (presumptive High/Very High)
listing.style: 1959 single-story ranch cabin; wood-burning stove, exposed beams, metal roof, raised composite deck
listing.description: Discover peaceful Rual living in the beautiful Weldon area! This unique property offers a quiet setting surrounded by the natural beauty of the Kern River Valley and southern Sierra mountains Enjoy open space, mountain scenery and the relaxed lifestyle the lake Isabella area is known for. Conveniently located within driving distance of lake Isabella, outdoor recreation, fishing, boating, hiking, and the Kern River. A great opportunity for those looking for privacy, space and a property away from the hustle of city living. Buyer to independent verify all property characteristics, boundaries, utiliteies, zonign, permitied uses and other information of importance to buyer.

condition.note: 1959 build; interiors dated but maintained (p_09, p_12, p_16); metal roof weathered/patchy (p_07); wood-stove heat + propane tank (p_25); water source/septic undisclosed — bottled-water packs (p_11) hint hauled/well issues

natural_light.note: Great room windows modest (p_09); bedroom bright (p_13); hallway/den dim (p_14, p_15) — cabin-typical, not a bright great-room differentiator

character.note: Exposed dark beams + wood stove (p_09), country decor, hand-dug hillside tunnel store-room (p_29) — quirky charm; exterior is a plain ranch box (p_33)

verdict: A $170k high-desert hideaway on 5 private acres with a genuinely good living-level valley panorama, Starlink, sheds, and flat usable pads — but it sits 6.6 hours from SF (Kern River Valley, past Bakersfield), which hard-fails the 3-hour getaway gate. For an SF buyer this is a two-flight-or-overnight-drive property: a fine cheap retreat for someone already in SoCal, a pass for the SF weekend-cabin hunt.
